name: Daito Trust Construction Co.,Ltd.
summary: Daito Trust Construction Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in construction, real estate leasing, real estate development, and other businesses in Japan. The company constructs apartments and condominiums; and planning, proposal, and construction of rental housing. It is also involved in the provision of brokerage and building management service; development and sale of residential and non-residential buildings, and overseas real estate.
